weapons.name: Memory Blade
weapons.description: A sword forged from crystallized memories. Cuts through the veil between past and present.

weapons.name: Echo Dagger
weapons.description: Leaves afterimages of its strikes. Each hit resonates with previous wounds.

weapons.name: Void Cleaver
weapons.description: Devours the memories of those it strikes. The wielder hears whispers of forgotten lives.

armor.name: Scavenger's Vest
armor.description: Patchwork armor stitched from ruins. Light but offers decent protection.

armor.name: Guardian's Plate
armor.description: Ancient armor worn by the first Memory Walkers. Heavy but nearly impenetrable.

armor.name: Crystal Carapace
armor.description: Living crystal that grows over the wearer. Reflects magic and heals slowly.

accessories.name: Memory Pendant
accessories.description: Glows faintly near memory fragments. Increases fragment find rate.

accessories.name: Phase Ring
accessories.description: Allows brief phasing through solid matter. Reduces dash cooldown.

accessories.name: Echo Amulet
accessories.description: Stores the echo of the last attack. Next attack deals bonus damage.

consumables.name: Memory Elixir
consumables.description: Restores health and mana. Tastes like your favorite childhood memory.

consumables.name: Clarity Potion
consumables.description: Removes all status effects and grants brief invincibility.

consumables.name: Fragment Shard
consumables.description: A piece of a larger memory. Combine 10 to form a Memory Fragment.

keys.name: Ruins Key
keys.description: Opens ancient doors in the Ruins biome. Engraved with a forgotten symbol.

keys.name: Sanctuary Key
keys.description: Grants access to the inner sanctum. Warm to the touch.

memories.name: Memory Fragment
memories.description: A piece of the world's lost history. Collect to reconstruct the truth.

memories.name: Core Memory
memories.description: A pivotal moment in the world's history. Radiates power.

memories.name: Primordial Memory
memories.description: The first memory of the world. Contains the secret of reconstruction.
